# cash
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package cash is paying with notes and coins: what the customer handed over, and the change the artist gives back.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `var Denominations = []money.Money{ ... }` | Denominations are the euro notes and coins the stand offers to tap, largest first. |
| `func Breakdown(amount money.Money) []money.Money` | Breakdown is the fewest notes and coins that make up an amount, largest first; what no denomination reaches (a cent or two) is left out. |
| `func Change(total money.Money, received Received) (change money.Money, enough bool)` | Change is what to give back for a total; enough is false while the customer has handed over less than the total, and change is then what is still missing, as a positive amount. |
| `func IsNote(piece money.Money) bool` | IsNote tells a note from a coin. |
| `type Received struct{ ... }` | Received is the notes and coins a customer hands over, tapped one by one. |
